    "Initial setup for organizations and collections can be less intuitive",
    "Occasional friction with autofill or master password prompts"

  "overall_experience": "The Product Design Lead found Bitwarden to be a highly effective and cost-efficient solution for centralizing and securely sharing team credentials. They appreciated its core functionality and robust security features, which met their team's needs for collaborative access. While the user interface sometimes lacked the visual polish of competitors, its practical usability and strong value proposition made it a solid choice for their mid-market company."
